summary: Backend testing of sector-specialization for CEO AI outputs. Verified that build_system_prompt injects sector-specific vocabulary and that /api/report, /api/signals adapt per company sector, that /api/ceo-daily still returns valid JSON, and that saving the company invalidates the AI cache so subsequent responses regenerate. 5/5 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: core.py build_system_prompt correctly derives sector from company.sector OR profile.activity fallback, and includes CAE if present — good defensive design.
companies.POST /company calls invalidate_ai_cache after save — verified: switching sector produces a fresh regeneration on subsequent /report and /signals calls.
Owner company 'Obelisco' is being mutated by these tests (sector left as 'restaurante / restauração' at end). Not restored — main agent may want to reset it if the owner account is used by others.
seed_data_creation: None. Test mutates the owner's company sector between 'restaurante / restauração' and 'construção civil'. Final state: restaurante.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_sector_specialization.py logs into obeliscoradical@gmail.com, toggles sector, and greps whole-word restaurant/construction terms in /api/report + /api/signals JSON (fully flattened). Distinctive construction terms used: empreitada, adjudica*, estaleiro, subempreiteir*, alvará, dono de obra (avoids false positives from generic 'obra'/'mão de obra'/'materiais'/'orçamento' which any business report uses). Restaurant terms: food cost, ementa (word-bounded to avoid 'incrementa'), mesas, rotação de mesas, turnos, cozinha, restaurant*. AI cold calls take 30-90s; total suite runs ~2min. Endpoints exercised: /api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/company (GET/POST), /api/report, /api/signals, /api/ceo-daily.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial test iterations had false positives from over-broad term lists (e.g. 'obras', 'mão de obra', 'materiais', 'rotação', 'ticket médio' are common cross-sector Portuguese business vocabulary). Tightened to sector-exclusive terms and all 5 tests passed.
